meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 dial 命令行通过 Dial 平台发短信、打 AI 语音电话、接收入站短信和验证码,不用自己写 HTTP 请求。首次使用时它会先查看命令行帮助和官方文档,再按流程执行。
howto.when: 当你提到电话、短信、验证码(OTP/2FA)等词,或要求给某人发短信、打电话、等一个验证码时;以及在同一会话里首次运行 dial 命令之前,它都会先加载本技能。

say.text: 用 dial 给 +14155550123 发条短信:货已发出
say.note: 发送前会先加载技能并核对流程

say.text: 用 dial 给 +14155550123 打个语音电话,通知对方会议改期
say.note: 通话结束后可取回状态和结果

say.text: 盯着短信,收到验证码就告诉我
say.note: 用 wait-for 等待入站验证码

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the dial CLI to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts and codes via the Dial platform, without writing HTTP code. It checks the CLI help and official docs first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention phones, calls, texts, SMS, OTP, 2FA, or codes; ask to text or call someone or wait for a code; or before the first dial command in a session.

say_en.text: Use dial to text +14155550123: the order has shipped
Use dial to call +14155550123 and say the meeting moved
say_en.note: You can fetch the call result after it ends

say_en.text: Watch for SMS and tell me the code when it arrives
